scientific_integrity: A complete first-step proof and symbolic rational identity are supplied. An independent rational finite-chain solver tests seven parameter triples; finite tests alone are not treated as proof. No physical or larger-population inference is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-individual, three-allele, well-mixed, mutation-free, constant-positive-fitness Moran birth--death process is covered. The comparator is an exact two-type Moran law, not the Kimura diffusion formula. General finite-state recurrences and two-type absorption formulas are prior art. Literature coverage is nonexhaustive.
title: Sharp variance-dependent sign reversals of competitor averaging in three-allele Moran fixation
